lines.zh: 我压低身子穿过草丛，肩胛在动。
lines.en: I move low through the grass, shoulders working.

lines.zh: 爪子踩过落叶，几乎不出声。
lines.en: Paws cross the dead leaves almost silently.

lines.zh: 我沿着平原边缘走，风在侧后。
lines.en: I walk the plain's edge with the wind behind my flank.

lines.zh: 长牙垂着，走路时碰不到东西。
lines.en: My long fangs hang down and catch on nothing.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但每一步都很稳。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but every step is sure.

lines.zh: 前面有一条兽径，我顺着它。
lines.en: A game trail ahead; I take it.

lines.zh: 我围着猎物留下的足迹转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the tracks my prey left behind.

lines.zh: 肩背的肌肉一鼓一收，很沉。
lines.en: The muscle in my shoulders swells and sinks, heavy.

lines.zh: 我绕过石堆，影子贴着地面。
lines.en: I slip past the rocks, my shadow flat on the ground.

lines.zh: 草叶擦过我的肋侧，有点痒。
lines.en: Grass brushes my ribs and tickles.

lines.zh: 我停一下，把耳朵转向左边。
lines.en: I pause and swing an ear left.

lines.zh: 再往前走就是它的地盘了。
lines.en: A few paces more and I'm in its range.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过灌木，我立刻放轻。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the brush; I soften my step at once.

lines.zh: 我半趴着走，肚子几乎贴土。
lines.en: I move half crouched, belly near the dirt.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，只有尾巴尖在摆。
lines.en: I stand still, only my tail tip moving.

lines.zh: 喉咙里有低低的声音，很轻。
lines.en: A low sound sits in my throat, very quiet.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔长牙，牙根有点钝。
lines.en: I lick my fangs; their roots feel blunt.

lines.zh: 这片草里有别的气味，很旧。
lines.en: There's another scent in this grass, an old one.

lines.zh: 风变了，我把鼻子抬起来。
lines.en: The wind shifts and I lift my nose.

lines.zh: 我趴下来，前爪叠在一起。
lines.en: I lie down and cross my forepaws.

lines.zh: 阳光照在背上，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Sun on my back makes my eyes narrow.

lines.zh: 我在等，等一个不必追的机会。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a chance that needs no chase.

lines.zh: 呼吸很慢，胸口起伏很小。
lines.en: My breath is slow, my chest barely rising.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在枝上，我看了一会儿。
lines.en: A bird lands on a branch; I watch it a while.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，头一动不动。
lines.en: I hold you in my stare, head unmoving.

lines.zh: 你把重量压在一条腿上了，我注意到了。
lines.en: Your weight is on one leg; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，露出那对长牙。
lines.en: I part my jaws and show the pair of fangs.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是看你。
lines.en: I make no sound; I only look.

lines.zh: 你在犹豫该不该退。
lines.en: You're deciding whether to back away.

lines.zh: 我比你矮，可我并不小。
lines.en: I'm shorter than you, and hardly small.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵贴平了，你该懂这意思。
lines.en: My ears are flat; you should read that.

lines.zh: 你攥着的那玩意儿，我没见过。
lines.en: That thing you're clutching — I've never seen anything like it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把重心移到后腿。
lines.en: I ease my weight onto my hind legs.

lines.zh: 你要跑，我会先动。
lines.en: Run, and I'll be first to move.

lines.zh: 我痛得翻了个身，又爬起来。
lines.en: Pain turns me over; I scramble up again.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我的牙从它身上滑开。
lines.en: The blow knocks my grip loose from its hide.

lines.zh: 血从我肋侧滴到草上。
lines.en: Blood drips from my ribs onto the grass.

lines.zh: 我低吼着后退，牙还露着。
lines.en: I retreat growling, fangs still bare.

lines.zh: 后腿打了个软，我硬撑着没趴。
lines.en: My hind legs buckle, but I force myself not to drop.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把痛甩到一边。
lines.en: I shake my head and shove the pain aside.

lines.zh: 呼吸里带了血腥味。
lines.en: There's blood in my own breath.

lines.zh: 我护住肚子，缩起后腿。
lines.en: I guard my belly and tuck my hind legs.

lines.zh: 这一击打在肩上，我歪了一下。
lines.en: A hit to the shoulder and I list sideways.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只是更低了。
lines.en: I don't cry out; I crouch lower.

lines.zh: 那块肉的气味，我不需要再看。
lines.en: I don't need a second look at that meat.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，一步一步过来。
lines.en: I lower my head and come a step at a time.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，抖了我就扑。
lines.en: Keep your hand steady; if it shakes I'll spring.

lines.zh: 活物的味道比死肉香。
lines.en: Living flesh smells sweeter than dead meat.

lines.zh: 我舔了下鼻子，停住了。
lines.en: I lick my nose and stop.

lines.zh: 这么点不够我嚼，可我先要着。
lines.en: It's hardly enough, but I'll take it.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面，再靠近。
lines.en: I circle to your flank and close in from there.

lines.zh: 肉一落地，我就不客气了。
lines.en: Once that meat hits the ground, I hold nothing back.

lines.zh: 这一口吞下去，我才抬头看你。
lines.en: I'll swallow, then look up at you.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，我跳起来够。
lines.en: Lift it higher and I'll leap for it.

lines.zh: 我被撞得侧了半步，立刻稳住。
lines.en: The shove takes me half a step; I plant at once.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我闻到你身上的汗。
lines.en: We collide and I catch the sweat on you.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，肩膀顶回去。
lines.en: I growl and drive back with my shoulder.

lines.zh: 爪子在土里划出四道痕。
lines.en: My claws leave four lines in the dirt.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我牙磕了一下。
lines.en: The impact clicks my fangs together.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，不想在这里浪费力气。
lines.en: I sidestep; I won't spend strength here.

lines.zh: 草被我们压出一片平地。
lines.en: We flatten a patch of grass between us.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩到你腿上。
lines.en: My tail whips across your leg.

lines.zh: 你比我壮，可我不退。
lines.en: You're heavier, and I don't give ground.

lines.zh: 我退开两步，重新压低身子。
lines.en: I back two paces and crouch again.

lines.zh: 我们并排走着，谁也没先开口。
lines.en: We walk abreast, neither speaking first.

lines.zh: 我用下巴蹭它的头顶。
lines.en: I rub my chin over the top of its head.

lines.zh: 它的长牙比我的短一截。
lines.en: Its fangs are a finger shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在草地上滚了半圈。
lines.en: We tumble half a turn in the grass.

lines.zh: 它咬我的后颈，我忍着不动。
lines.en: It nips my nape and I hold still.

lines.zh: 这一带有足够的水和猎物。
lines.en: There's water and game enough here.

lines.zh: 它走远一点，我立刻跟上。
lines.en: It moves off; I follow at once.

lines.zh: 我们对着同一片夜色低鸣。
lines.en: We rumble at the same stretch of night.

lines.zh: 我的气味留在它的毛上。
lines.en: My scent stays in its fur.

lines.zh: 这段日子我们共用一条兽径。
lines.en: For now we share one trail.

lines.zh: 我咬住肉，牙齿陷得很深。
lines.en: I bite the meat and my fangs sink deep.

lines.zh: 这块骨头比我的头还粗。
lines.en: This bone is thicker than my skull.

lines.zh: 我叼着它退到草丛里。
lines.en: I carry it back into the grass.

lines.zh: 牙齿卡住了，我甩了两下。
lines.en: My fangs catch; I shake twice.

lines.zh: 我把它压在爪下，先看看四周。
lines.en: I pin it under a paw and check around first.

lines.zh: 这么小块，我一口就没了。
lines.en: A scrap this small is gone in one bite.

lines.zh: 我把剩下的埋进浅土。
lines.en: I bury what's left in shallow soil.

lines.zh: 叼着这块，我连低吼都漏风。
lines.en: With this in my jaws, even my growl leaks air.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔嘴角的血。
lines.en: I lick the blood from the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 它还有温度，我不急着吞。
lines.en: It's still warm; I take my time.

lines.zh: 我看到了，就别无选择。
lines.en: I've seen it, and there's no other choice now.

lines.zh: 耳朵向前，我把身体贴地。
lines.en: Ears forward, I flatten my body.

lines.zh: 它的腿有伤，我盯的就是那条腿。
lines.en: Its leg is hurt — that's the leg I want.

lines.zh: 风正好，它闻不到我。
lines.en: The wind is right; it can't smell me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把爪子收进肉垫。
lines.en: I ease my claws back into their pads.

lines.zh: 距离二十步，我还能再近些。
lines.en: Twenty paces; I can get closer still.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音停了。
lines.en: The sound in my throat stops.

lines.zh: 它转过来，我立刻不动。
lines.en: It turns; I freeze.

lines.zh: 这个猎物值得我等。
lines.en: This one is worth the wait.

lines.zh: 我记住了它逃走的方向。
lines.en: I've marked the way it would run.

lines.zh: 它的心跳我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I can hear its heartbeat plainly.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵压平，只留眼睛。
lines.en: I flatten my ears and keep only my eyes.

lines.zh: 爪子从肉垫里伸出来，一声不响。
lines.en: My claws slide out without a sound.

lines.zh: 它身边有两只同伙，先挑最弱的。
lines.en: Two others are with it; I'll take the weakest.

lines.zh: 顺着这个斜角，它瞧不见我。
lines.en: From this side angle it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我先磨了磨后爪，试试地面。
lines.en: I scuff my hind paws to test the ground.

lines.zh: 我跟在它后面，永远差一步。
lines.en: I stay behind it, always one step short.

lines.zh: 它开始跑了，我也放开步子。
lines.en: It breaks into a run; I let my stride out.

lines.zh: 前面的坡会拖慢它。
lines.en: The slope ahead will slow it.

lines.zh: 我从左侧绕，截它的路。
lines.en: I swing left to cut it off.

lines.zh: 肌肉绷起来，我随时能扑。
lines.en: My muscles coil; I can spring at any moment.

lines.zh: 它回头看了两次，我都没停。
lines.en: It looks back twice and I don't slow.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下翻起土块。
lines.en: Clods of earth kick up under me.

lines.zh: 它想上树，可树干太细。
lines.en: It means to climb, but the trunk is too thin.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，等它进射程。
lines.en: I count the paces until it's in range.

lines.zh: 尾巴压低，我把重心前移。
lines.en: Tail low, I push my weight forward.

lines.zh: 它被灌木绊了一下。
lines.en: It stumbles on the brush.

lines.zh: 就是现在，它慢了。
lines.en: Now — it's slowed.

lines.zh: 我再近三步就够得着。
lines.en: Three more paces and it's within reach.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬满，我把自己射出去。
lines.en: My hind legs load and I launch myself.

lines.zh: 牙齿先到，爪子随后。
lines.en: The fangs arrive first, the claws after.

lines.zh: 它撞开草丛往前冲。
lines.en: It bursts through the grass and drives on.

lines.zh: 我贴着它侧面，不让它转向。
lines.en: I hug its flank so it can't turn.

lines.zh: 它的喘息粗起来，我知道快了。
lines.en: Its breathing grows ragged; I know the moment is near.

lines.zh: 我闻到了血，距离不远了。
lines.en: I smell blood; it isn't far now.

lines.zh: 最后一步，我不再等了。
lines.en: One last step — no more waiting.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，长牙直插它的颈。
lines.en: I launch, fangs driving at its neck.

lines.zh: 前爪扣住它的肩，我压下去。
lines.en: My forepaws hook its shoulder and I bear down.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬进去，我甩头撕开。
lines.en: My fangs sink in and I wrench my head.

lines.zh: 它甩开我，我落地翻身又来。
lines.en: It throws me off; I land, roll, and come again.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在骨头上，震得牙疼。
lines.en: This bite lands on bone and jars my teeth.

lines.zh: 我用整副体重把它按倒。
lines.en: I use my whole weight to bear it down.

lines.zh: 爪子在它身上留下三道口子。
lines.en: My claws leave three long openings.

lines.zh: 它举手护脸，我扑它小腹。
lines.en: It guards its face; I go for its belly.

lines.zh: 长牙卡住了，我用力抽出来。
lines.en: My fangs lodge; I wrench them free.

lines.zh: 血溅到我眼睛上，我眨眼。
lines.en: Blood spatters my eyes and I blink.

lines.zh: 我咬它后腿，让它站不起来。
lines.en: I take its hind leg so it can't rise.

lines.zh: 它比我快，我只能贴身。
lines.en: It's quicker than me, so I stay pressed close.

lines.zh: 一扑没中，我打个滚再起。
lines.en: A missed leap; I roll and rise.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙贴着它的喉咙。
lines.en: My throat presses against its throat.

lines.zh: 它想跑，我一爪拍在它背上。
lines.en: It tries to run; my paw lands on its back.

lines.zh: 我撕下一块，退开两步喘气。
lines.en: I tear a piece loose and back off panting.

lines.zh: 它倒下了，我还不松口。
lines.en: It's down and I still don't let go.

lines.zh: 肩膀一阵酸，我换另一只爪。
lines.en: My shoulder aches; I switch paws.

lines.zh: 牙卡进肉里，我等到它不再挣。
lines.en: My fangs lodge in flesh and I wait until it stops struggling.

lines.zh: 这一顿够我撑好几天。
lines.en: This kill will carry me several days.

lines.zh: 我从长草里站起来，肩背先露出来。
lines.en: I rise out of the tall grass, shoulders first.

lines.zh: 第一声低吼从胸腔里滚出来。
lines.en: The first growl rolls out of my chest.

lines.zh: 爪子抓着地，我试了试力气。
lines.en: Claws gripping the soil, I test my strength.

lines.zh: 长牙碰在下唇上，有点凉。
lines.en: My fangs rest cold against my lower lip.

lines.zh: 四周是平原，风里有兽味。
lines.en: Plains all around, and game on the wind.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，先找掩体。
lines.en: I crouch and look for cover first.

lines.zh: 这里的草够高，藏得住我。
lines.en: The grass is tall enough to hide me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，把整片原野看了一遍。
lines.en: I raise my head and take in the whole plain.

lines.zh: 土是暖的，我把爪子埋进去。
lines.en: The soil is warm; I sink my claws into it.

lines.zh: 远处有东西在吃草，我记住了。
lines.en: Something grazes far off; I note it.

lines.zh: 肩骨一耸，我知道自己饿了。
lines.en: My shoulders roll and I know I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 影子落在我身上，这是起点。
lines.en: A shadow falls over me — this is where it starts.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，草向两侧倒。
lines.en: I take my first step and the grass parts.

lines.zh: 这片平原从今天起有主了。
lines.en: This plain has a master from today.

lines.zh: 火舔过我的毛，我一跃跳开。
lines.en: Fire licks my fur and I leap clear.

lines.zh: 落地的冲击顺着四条腿上来。
lines.en: The landing shock runs up all four legs.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我疯狂扑腾。
lines.en: Water floods my nose and I thrash wildly.

lines.zh: 爆开的气浪把我掀进草里。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the grass.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿进肩肉，我咬住箭杆。
lines.en: An arrow buries in my shoulder; I bite the shaft.

lines.zh: 那股光打中我，四肢不听使唤。
lines.en: The light strikes and my legs won't answer.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我的爪子都在抖。
lines.en: Too long hungry; even my claws tremble.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我的毛全炸开了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and my fur stands on end.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我一直往下坠。
lines.en: Nothing under my feet; I keep falling.
